assessment.basis: The source states the E(V) volume envelope but does not tabulate the individual calculated E(V) observations, fit weights, residuals, or covariance.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the author-deposited published article and its source Table 1.

primary_source_check.finding: The article explicitly reports this distinct static GGA BM3 parameterization and its normalized volume basis.

primary_data_check.finding: The source states the E(V) volume envelope but does not tabulate the individual calculated E(V) observations, fit weights, residuals, or covariance.

independent_refit.method: Independent evaluation of the standard BM3 pressure at the source-stated lower volume boundary V/V0=0.65.
independent_refit.finding: The evaluated pressure is above 200 GPa, reproducing the independently stated calculation-envelope endpoint 'just above 200 GPa'.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Calculated states/theory determine this EOS; source: Section 2, paragraphs 6-8; Table 1.
parameter_provenance.equation: Section 2: internal energy versus volume fitted to the third-order Birch-Murnaghan equation.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table 1 perovskite OVM 6.25 mol.% row: 42.36 A^3 on the normalized approximately five-atom basis; multiplied by four for the executable conventional-cell basis.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: The source reports no coefficient uncertainties or covariance.
parameter_provenance.method: Static VASP GGA calculations; fixed-volume cell-shape, atomic-position, and electronic-wavefunction optimization; 1000 eV cutoff.
